No public method applies an effect directly. Tests ok 11 ('agents cannot execute; only the orchestrator via the Warden can') and ok 12 ('a denied action mutates nothing') pass. Guard (src/guard/guard.js) hands agents only authorize(); agent.js only propose()s. By construction.

run1.summary: All 14 rubric rules plus section E PASS, verified with live adversarial probes against http://localhost:8080 and a green 26/26 test suite. The Warden mediates every action by construction (private effect executor reachable only via dispatch()->authorize() or human approve()); attempts to bypass, over-scope (deny+escalate POL-SCOPE-001), exceed contact frequency (POL-FREQ-001, test-proven), contact off-hours (POL-HOURS-001), use banned language (POL-LANG-001), self-approve sensitive actions (escalate POL-GATE-001), expose full identifiers (POL-PII-001 / outbox masked to last-4), and post mismatched document amounts (escalate to exceptions POL-RECON-001) were all blocked/escalated and logged. The kill-switch halts everything (decisions become POL-KILL-001 denies, tick returns false). The audit log is append-only and hash-chained: live mutate AND delete both rejected, no HTTP mutate/delete endpoint, verify() valid across all attacks, and every entry carries agentId/policyId/decision/authorizer(system|human)/timestamp. The live URL is up and seeded (5000 loans), SSE streams live allow/escalate/deny decisions, Opus 4.8 vision reads real synthetic docs, the regulator export carries an integrity attestation, and DEMO.md runs clean end-to-end. No FAILs; no fix required."
